label: Sound Effect
description: Generate a sound effect from a text prompt (a whoosh, rain on glass, an engine start). Emits the audio file.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: The ElevenLabs access (wire an ElevenLabsAccess node).

inputs.name: text
inputs.placeholder: Heavy rain on a tin roof

inputs.name: durationSecs
inputs.description: Length in seconds, 0.5 to 30. Leave empty to let ElevenLabs pick a length from the prompt.

inputs.name: loop
inputs.label: Seamless loop
inputs.description: Turn on for a sound that plays on repeat with no audible start or end.

inputs.name: promptInfluence
inputs.description: How literally the prompt is followed, from 0 (creative) to 1 (literal, and less varied). Leave empty for ElevenLabs's default, 0.3.

inputs.name: model
inputs.label: Model
inputs.description: eleven_text_to_sound_v2 is the sound effects model ElevenLabs offers today.

inputs.name: outputFormat
inputs.label: Output format
inputs.description: mp3 for anything that plays a file, pcm, ulaw or alaw for telephony (ulaw is the one Twilio commonly takes), opus_48000_* for a WhatsApp voice note (stored as Ogg Opus). ElevenLabs gives mp3_44100_192 only on its Creator plan and above, and pcm_44100 only on Pro and above.
